title: AWAKE AND WALK IN LIGHT
A MORNING PRAYER ON EPHESIANS 5
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer

scenes.a: You hit snooze hoping today might wait.
scenes.sub: YOU HIT SNOOZE HOPING TODAY WAITS

scenes.a: Yet the morning sunlight already touches your floor.
Hear the word of the Lord:
scenes.sub: HEAR THE WORD OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Lord, shake the heavy slumber from our weary souls.
scenes.sub: SHAKE THE HEAVY SLUMBER FROM US

scenes.a: Teach us to walk carefully today, choosing Your wisdom over quiet distraction.
Help us redeem every hour You give us with steady purpose.
Guide our steps into Your everlasting light.
scenes.sub: GUIDE OUR STEPS IN YOUR LIGHT

scenes.a: Amen. You hit snooze hoping today might wait.
